sentences.en: Layla can't bear to see her family dissolve before her.
sentences.zh: 拉耶拉无法忍受看到自己的家庭在她眼前解散。

sentences.en: Sami crushed the poisonous pills and dissolved them into juice.
sentences.zh: 萨米把有毒的药丸碾碎并溶解在果汁里。

sentences.en: Sugar will dissolve in a glass of water quickly.

senses.zh: 使溶解，解散，消除，解决(问题)，使沮丧
消散，溶解，解散液化，变得模糊
